card.name: Separators in menu and link lists
card.fires_on: The space or dash right after a list item in a scraped web menu, link list or index, just before the next item begins. It also fires on a dash after a heading.

modes.label: Gap after menu item
modes.description: A blank or space token after a menu or list entry, before the next entry or new text.
modes.example: - St Andrews<< >>I also cover Edinburgh and the Loth

modes.label: Dash between list items
modes.description: A hyphen or dash that separates one item from the next in a site menu or a heading line.
modes.example: - Join The Movement <<->> Media & More - About Us

card.plain: It marks the break between items in a pasted website menu or list, where a new entry starts.
